title: fix: restore Scout with Vercel primary and Novita fallback
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Routes `meta/llama-4-scout` through **Vercel → DeepInfra**, then **OpenRouter → Novita BF16**. Exact upstream IDs: `meta/llama-4-scout` on `ai-gateway.vercel.sh/v1`; `meta-llama/llama-4-scout` on `openrouter.ai/api/v1`, pinned `novita/bf16`, provider fallback disabled. Removes the extra route.
- Preserves aliases `llama-4-scout`, `llama-scout-17b`, `llama-4-scout-17b-16e-instruct`, `llama-scout`; paid-only, multiplier **1**, no Pollinations GPU. Customer price: **$0.10/$0.30 per million tokens**. Novita logged costs: **$0.18/$0.59 × 1.055**; Pollinations absorbs the difference. Sources: [Vercel](https://vercel.com/ai-gateway/models/llama-4-scout), [OpenRouter](https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models/meta-llama/llama-4-scout/endpoints).
- **Approved breaking change:** the primary supports tools/structured output; Scout disables both to share Novita’s capabilities. Affected clients must choose another model. Keeps text/vision, 10 images, streaming, existing endpoints, 16,384 output tokens. Live primary rejects 150k input and reports **131,072 context**.
- **Catalog-wide validation:** existing image limits and `tools: false` now produce upfront 400s. Catalog exposes `supports_structured_output` and `max_completion_tokens`; Responses errors use `invalid_request_error`. Allows inert parallel-tools defaults.
- Verified: prior **310 tests**, **98 follow-up tests**, **109 Enter billing tests**, **105 Gen error/capability tests**, TypeScript/Biome, live primary/forced-fallback usage, vision, streaming, long prompts, bursts, wallet/cache/billing. Novita sample: **$0.0000092207 cost / $0.0000048 charge**. Small bursts do not establish production capacity. Removed the unused Vertex flag; no deployment/secrets changed.

gist.headline: Scout finds the trail
gist.blurb: Llama 4 Scout is back in the garden, taking the Vercel path first and a carefully pinned Novita path when needed. The signposts are clearer too: unsupported image or tool requests now get an answer before they wander into the woods.
gist.summary: Restored `meta/llama-4-scout` with Vercel AI Gateway → DeepInfra as primary and an OpenRouter route pinned to Novita BF16 as fallback, while catalog validation now exposes structured-output support and completion limits with upfront capability errors.
gist.impact: Scout again supports text, vision, streaming, up to 10 images, and 16,384 output tokens at $0.10/$0.30 per million tokens; clients also get immediate 400 errors for unsupported image, tools, or structured-output requests and can select another model when those capabilities are required.
gist.visual_concept: A restored Scout route is a cozy forked garden trail: a Vercel/DeepInfra signpost is the bright primary path, while a smaller OpenRouter-to-Novita signpost provides a dependable backup trail. Polli, wearing a tiny ranger hat and holding a map, guides a CRT monitor robot past clear capability placards for text, vision, streaming, and tools disabled; code-plants and flowers make the routing system feel maintained rather than mysterious.
